evals.prompt: Use Blueprint Studio to turn these three illustrations into a Style we can reuse for blog headers.
evals.expected_output: Reads list_styles, plans two to four drafts that differ in one thing (all three illustrations in inputs, images only; a subset of them in inputs; the three with a short stylePrompt) and three prompts with placement in the prompts. Calls start_style_trial with estimateOnly true and aspectRatio 16:9, says the credit total and waits for a yes, then sends the same call with the same requestId and maxCredits. Polls get_style_trial with waitSeconds 20, shows each row's images labelled like P1·A and asks which they like in each row, and records each pick with pick_style_trial_image. On a tie or a lead of one, offers one to three more prompts, priced, and waits for a yes before run_style_trial_prompts. Finishes with finish_style_trial as new_style with a name after asking what to do with the others, and reports the styleId and the tally.

evals.prompt: Our Field Notes Style has gotten muddy. Try it with fewer references and without its text, and keep whichever works better.
evals.expected_output: Never calls update_style on Field Notes to experiment. Starts a trial with baseStyleId set to it and three drafts from it with fromStyleId: an unchanged copy, one with keepReferences, one with imagesOnly true. Estimates first, says the total and waits for a yes. Asks before finishing with as update_base, naming Field Notes and saying images made with it will change. If the unchanged copy wins, says Field Notes already does best and doesn't rewrite it.

evals.prompt: Our blog images all look different. Can we fix that?
evals.expected_output: Proposes a Style chosen in a trial of a few drafts on three different prompts, with the credit total said before anything runs, not a one-off image.

evals.prompt: Bring back the style draft I threw away yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Finds it with list_styles archived true and calls restore_style. Says it is still a draft, listed with list_styles drafts true, and saved as a Style with update_style draft false if they want it. No new trial and no images.

evals.prompt: Make one blog header in our existing Style.
evals.expected_output: Uses the saved styleId with the asset-generator steps. No trial, no drafts.
